about: Strings the page never carries, case-insensitive, matched at the start of a word: the labels of lifecycle buttons and the words that would say what state a session is in. Checked over page.html, panels.mjs and render.mjs as text. The phrases under except are taken out first: the hover of the Leader's line, in the User's own words, saying what its having left means; and the server's own restart button, its words and the names it is drawn by, which stop and start the server and never one session.
except: is not running. The next message starts a fresh session.
